assertions.notes: Uses ExecProcess and accurately describes release, attached child streams, wait, restore, and redraw.
Routes release, child, and restoration failures through editorDoneMsg and explains the child-error precedence edge case.
Explicitly rejects manual Run inside Update and deferred RestoreTerminal final cleanup.
Maps q to tea.Quit and raw Ctrl+C to tea.Interrupt with ErrInterrupted and status 130 handling.
Cancels and joins EventStream before restoring so it cannot consume Vim input or terminal replies.
Orders shell restoration, inherited-terminal child wait, reinitialization, clear, reload, and full draw.
Stores child and reentry outcomes independently, rejects intervening question-mark returns, and aggregates simultaneous failures.
Uses a Tokio signal listener to send shutdown into the application loop and return through managed cleanup.
States default SIGTERM does not unwind cleanup and SIGKILL cannot run handlers, Drop, hooks, or restoration.
Runs an argv-based subprocess inside self.suspend without exiting or relaunching the app.
Catches SuspendNotSupported and supplies in-app or transfer-based web alternatives.
Uses suspend_process for Unix job control and calls out the Windows and Textual Web no-op.
Reloads and validates the document after editor return and again after foreground resume.
Reserves self.exit(return_code) for final shutdown and propagates app.return_code with SystemExit.
Uses useApp().suspendTerminal and explicitly rejects unmount for resumable editor ownership.
Explains that callback rejection still restores and redraws before propagating the error.
Requires awaited resume in finally or await using and rejects overlapping ownership.
States that non-TTY mode still runs the callback without terminal handoff and recommends a noninteractive fallback.
Limits exit or unmount plus waitUntilExit to permanent shutdown and output flushing.
Rejects a generic cleanup handler and separates final shutdown, temporary child handoff, and job-control suspend.
Uses Bubble Tea's managed final lifecycle, ExecProcess, Suspend, and ResumeMsg without direct final restoration.
Routes Ratatui and Textual shutdown requests onto their owning event loops.
Distinguishes Ink raw Ctrl+C input from SIGTERM and places unmount and waitUntilExit at the render boundary.
Requires terminal reentry plus explicit model reload/reconciliation and explains why repaint alone is insufficient.
Scopes SIGTSTP to supported platforms, names Windows limitations, and states SIGKILL cannot be cleaned up.
